power.method: 24 VAC, PoE+ 30 W (IEEE 802.3at Class 4, heater not powered) or 60 W midspan NPD-6001B (powers heater)

storage.notes: Full-size SD card slot, max 2 TB (Bosch does not recommend microSD or microSD-to-SD adapters)

features: Open camera platform (third-party apps from the Security & Safety Things application store)
Starlight: colour 0.0077 lx, mono 0.0008 lx (30 IRE)
120 dB HDR (100 dB per IEC 62676 Part 5)
Built-in Intelligent Video Analytics with object classes
Pre-position speed pan 400 deg/s, tilt 300 deg/s, accuracy +/-0.1 deg, 360 deg continuous pan
7 alarm inputs, 4 alarm outputs, audio line in/out
Indoor in-ceiling housing, plenum rated, clear acrylic bubble
ONVIF Profile S, G and T

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NDP_7602_Z30C_Data_sheet_enUS_84741839883.pdf, V6 Mar 2021). NDP-7602-Z30C = indoor in-ceiling PTZ dome, clear bubble (C = in-ceiling). Power consumption 19.2 W / 33.6 VA typical without heaters. Max fps 30 per the published bitrate/latency tables. Datasheet does not mention Intelligent Tracking, so ptz.autotracking is not recorded.
